info.name: Qlty
info.description: Qlty is a code quality and coverage platform from the team behind Code Climate, combining the free Rust-based Qlty CLI with the hosted Qlty Cloud service. Qlty does not publish a documented public REST API, so this collection does not contain live HTTP API requests. Instead it documents Qlty's real surfaces: the Qlty CLI commands (including coverage publishing) and the official documentation and source links. Coverage is uploaded with `qlty coverage publish` authenticated by the QLTY_COVERAGE_TOKEN environment variable.

item.name: Qlty CLI
item.description: The free, Rust-based Qlty CLI for linting, auto-formatting, security scanning, code smells, duplication, and maintainability metrics. This is a local command-line tool, not an HTTP API. Install with `curl https://qlty.sh | sh`. Configuration lives in .qlty/qlty.toml.

request.description: Documentation for the Qlty CLI. Key commands: qlty init, qlty check, qlty fmt, qlty smells, qlty metrics.
Qlty CLI source (Rust, Fair Source / BSL 1.1). Free for all use including commercial projects.

item.name: Qlty Coverage Upload
item.description: Coverage publishing via the CLI command `qlty coverage publish <report-file>`, authenticated by the per-project QLTY_COVERAGE_TOKEN environment variable. Supported formats: lcov, Cobertura, Clover, JaCoCo, SimpleCov, dotCover, xccov-json. No documented public REST upload endpoint exists.

request.description: Example: `qlty coverage publish coverage/lcov.info` with $QLTY_COVERAGE_TOKEN set in the environment. Use --format to specify the report format and --add-prefix / --strip-prefix to adjust file paths.
Supported coverage report formats and per-language configuration (lcov, Cobertura, Clover, JaCoCo, SimpleCov, dotCover, xccov-json, qlty jsonl).

item.name: Qlty Cloud
item.description: Qlty Cloud is the hosted platform for automated pull request review, quality gates, trends, and dashboards. It is consumed through Git provider integrations (GitHub App / Action) and the web app rather than a documented public REST API.

request.description: Overview of Qlty CLI and Qlty Cloud, and the relationship to Code Climate.

variable.description: Per-project coverage token supplied to `qlty coverage publish` as an environment variable. Documented as a CLI env var, not a documented public REST API header.
